units.source_text: 到了三月里，天色晴朗，小公子薰君诞生已五十天，要举行庆祝了。

en.t: In March, when the weather was clear, fifty days had passed since the young lord Kaoru was born, and a celebration was to be held.

units.source_text: 这小公子长得粉妆玉琢，娇美可爱，而且非常肥硕，

en.t: The young lord was as fair and polished as carved jade, charming and lovely, and also very plump,

units.source_text: 好像不止五十天似的，那小口儿已想牙牙学语了。

en.t: as if he were far more than fifty days old; his little mouth already seemed eager to babble its first words.

units.source_text: 源氏来到三公主房中，说道：“你心情快适了么？

en.t: Genji came to the Third Princess's room and said, "Are you feeling more comfortable now?

units.source_text: 唉！你这模样真教人看了失望啊！

en.t: Ah, seeing you like this truly makes one feel disappointed.

units.source_text: 如果你同从前一样打扮，我看见你恢复了健康，多么欢喜啊！

en.t: If only you dressed as you used to, how happy I would be to see that you had recovered your health.

units.source_text: 你舍弃了我而出家，使我很伤心呢！”

en.t: You abandoned me and took religious vows, and it has grieved me deeply."
With tears streaming down his face, he poured out his sorrow.

units.source_text: 他每天来看望一次，对三公主的关怀反比从前殷勤了。

en.t: He came once every day to visit her, and his care for the Third Princess became even more attentive than before.
